children: Adient's net sales rose 4.4% and its net loss narrowed year over year, as higher production volumes in the Americas and Asia, favorable foreign currencies and commercial pricing lifted sales. Lower production volumes and unfavorable mix, higher SG&A and financing charges partially offset improved operating performance and the absence of the prior-year EMEA goodwill impairment.
